rule: Documented human adjudication takes precedence over conflicting older local automated extraction. Preserve source/raw values, repair history and unresolved flags. This does not imply every row was manually reviewed. Project identity and geographic attribution remain separate from PDF extraction quality.
documentaryAuthority: Official budget documents remain the underlying evidence; csiiiv is the preferred working dataset provider.
researchFocus: Complement upstream with reproducible project-level case files, asset/engineering context, strict geographic attribution, supporting and contrary evidence, and actionable verification steps.
reuseRule: Consume upstream extraction, identifiers, stage comparisons and existing analyses where adequate; implement only a documented missing enrichment or source correction.
availabilityRule: A stage not available upstream remains unavailable; do not substitute another stage or infer final appropriations.
migrationStatus: NIA/HFEP/FMR reviewed annex inputs adopted; remaining DPWH source and general matching paths still require migration to upstream outputs.
